title: Twelve two-base-pair helices: an exact designability bound for a fixed family in the maxStacks model
description: Article Version 1.4 and certificate package for a fixed RNA target family in the maxStacks model. A 71-base sequence uniquely designs T12; all D>=13 are excluded. The model allows GU pairs, forbids isolated pairs and requires j-i>=2, permitting hairpins with one unpaired base. The package supplies standard-library DP, rival and CNF checks, word-case coverage and U14 LRAT proofs. Large D13 DRAT/LRAT proofs are separate companions. The question comes from Boury, Bulteau and Ponty. No claim is made for arbitrary RNA trees, every D<=12, Turner energies, priority or experimental folding. This work has not undergone independent human peer review. Code: Apache 2.0; original prose, data and proof certificates: CC BY 4.0. Package 1.1.0 adds a separate zero-separator, one-base-hairpin maximum-25 supplement and three-base-hairpin designs at 16 and 21 as lower bounds only. Source: https://github.com/tkmt-lab/maxstacks-two-bp-helices/tree/v1.1.0.
